reviewed_by: Claude: goal closure review, focused backend, frontend and real-Core selection
reason: Goals get an opt-in completion_requires_review flag (default false), saved at create, update, goal-conversation create, fork and harness-to-provider handoff, and exposed to Butler's goal tools. With it on, an agent's accepted goal.complete (native provider turn settlement in chat.py and harness settlement in harnesses.py, through one shared agent_completion_changes helper) leaves the goal BLOCKED with blocked_reason 'Awaiting closure review' and metadata.completion_proposal instead of COMPLETED, so no continuation is dispatched; the tool result says pending_closure_review. The existing complete action now also accepts a goal awaiting review and completes it with the stored proposal; resume sends it back, records completion_review and prefixes the reviewer's reason to the resume turn. Core records goal.completion_review_requested (not goal.blocked, so Butler recovery does not treat it as an operational blocker) and Butler semantic review now includes it and goal.completed, with precedent queries. The goal panel, studio rail and phone goal button show Awaiting review with Approve completion and Send back; goal create/edit forms gain Hold completion for review. Selected: the new regression file (native and harness held completion, flag-off unchanged, approve, send back through the route, update keep/set, Butler event and packet, board line, Butler tool schemas), the goal, Butler review and oversight, harness goal and Butler work-tool suites, the runtime bundle check for the new entity-field digest, the product-knowledge and Chroma sync checks for the settings assistant, the harness claim-release test beside the edited settlement, the touched UI component and settings-assistant discovery tests, and the existing real-Core provider goal completion journey on desktop, Chromium 390 and WebKit 390 to prove flag-off completion and the panel are unchanged.
exclusions: tests/v3/test_product_knowledge.py is selected by test name: test_product_search_finds_headless_core_and_paired_butler_cli fails on origin/main without this change (verified by rebuilding the index from origin/main docs). tests/v3/test_universal_agent_tools.py's harness completion test does not await _prepare and is red on main, so the harness path is covered by the new file through _complete_owner and _settle_goal_turn instead. No native code. No committed real-Core browser journey for the review flow itself: real-core.spec.ts exceeds the public commit guard's per-file limit, so the approve and send-back browser journey was run against a disposable LAN Core from the production bundle and recorded in the PR. No full-suite approval.
